notes.title: Outland Rapture - Request your Playtest!
notes.content:
Our New Game is on the way!

We are very happy to present you our third game Outland Rapture - a mix between Stealth / Adventure and Story Driven.

The Story
Three strangers wake up in a mysterious place and working together without being noticed is the only way to survive all the dangers and return home.

Put on your Wishlist
If you like games in this genre, do not hesitate in adding it to your wishlist because there are a lot of news coming soon.

Request your Playtest
Help us make a better game for you!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1361900/Outland_Rapture/
